evidence: DJ Pierre and the other members of Phuture are documented as having brought Hardy early dubs of what became 'Acid Tracks' to play at the Music Box before its 1987 release.

trackPair.whatToListenFor: 'Acid Tracks' was reportedly played at the Music Box on cassette for months before release; Hardy's sets are part of why a twelve-minute record built from one squelching filter sweep had an audience ready for it.

explanation: Phuture tested "Acid Tracks" on tape at the Music Box before it was pressed, the same route Larry Heard and Marshall Jefferson used. It ties the story of the 303 machine to the club that actually got the record heard and, in the end, pressed.
